summary: Independent read-only audit of every external-provider integration chain (Cloudflare R2/uploads, Stripe billing, Autentique, DocuSign, WhatsApp Cloud, external-data distributor/society webhooks, Soundcharts, Abramus, Instagram/Meta OAuth, Resend mail) completed. 9 findings recorded (2 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 4 LOW): missing idempotency protection on Autentique/DocuSign document-creation and Abramus register-work (real external side effects, retry can double-apply), MailService->Resend lacking Idempotency-Key under BullMQ retry, GlobalExceptionFilter Sentry tenant/userId enrichment reading request properties that are never set (dead code), uploads raw-proxy missing R2 NoSuchKey handling untested by uploads-raw-proxy.spec.ts, InstagramTokenRefreshScheduler lacking cross-instance coordination, and a naming-hygiene issue in spotify/deezer artist-profile providers (no functional artistId/soundcharts-uuid conflation found -- persisted fields are genuinely distinct). Stripe webhook idempotency (payment_events unique constraint + reclaim logic), Autentique/DocuSign/WhatsApp webhook HMAC/shared-secret verification, and the uploads/raw tenant-scoping (query filters by tenant_id+file_id+deleted_at) were verified correct with no findings.
